authorityOrder.scope: current geometry, responsive behavior, interaction causality, and scroll mappings
authorityOrder.reason: The current live implementation is the single source of truth for observable runtime behavior.

authorityOrder.scope: the captured hero chronology, exact recorded frames, and appearance when live state cannot be held reproducibly
authorityOrder.reason: The repository-backed recording is the authoritative immutable capture supplied for this rebaseline.

decisions.decision: No external scratch path or opaque legacy capture alias is valid acceptance evidence.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Acceptance metadata may resolve only to the live URL or the repository recording SHA plus exact frame.

decisions.decision: Recording timestamps after journey scroll begins are seek anchors, not animation durations.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Physical scroll drives separate DOM and scene mappings. Loader, idle packets, field pulses, arrival marks, and source-observed ambient motion may use explicit local clocks with verified reset rules; recording seek times are not universal durations.

decisions.decision: When recording chronology cannot prove whether an effect is scroll-, time-, or pointer-driven, the current live site determines causality.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Unproven effects remain isolated/configurable until a live probe establishes their input.

decisions.decision: Pegasoft wording and identity glyphs may differ, but their layout containers, hierarchy, timing, and screen occupancy may not.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Retain raw images. Exclude only approved differing glyph/logo pixels, never whole text boxes or scene errors. S4 now reports the identity-sensitive raster as diagnostic with separate scene, visible-text, motion, provenance and user-review gates. No glyph mask or final visual acceptance was introduced; fresh runtime qualification remains S7.

decisions.decision: The four repository-owned semantic masks depict the vectrfl.com reference goal and are accepted as refinement inputs only.
decisions.implementationConsequence: The masks may derive measurements from their exact hash-locked source frames. They may not classify localhost implementation pixels, prove overlap, or confer structural or final visual acceptance.

decisions.decision: The replacement keeps the world root fixed and assigns the field-approach composition change to the camera.
decisions.implementationConsequence: No stage or world-root transform may compound the camera turn unless later live evidence explicitly disproves this model.

decisions.decision: The earlier coarse-pointer/profile rule conflated distinct source predicates. S0 verifies that the source Qt iOS/iPadOS/Android branch controls pointer omission and damping; viewport width and capture labels are not substitutes.
decisions.implementationConsequence: S2/S5 use the exact source predicate documented in repairs/s0/source/source-contract.md. No invented touch substitute; test UA, pointer capability, width, and capture identity independently. Responsive composition and physical-device qualification remain open.

decisions.decision: No camera, route, progress, timing, color, or geometry constant is retained merely because it exists in the old Pegasoft renderer.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Replacement values require live/recording evidence and deterministic tests.

decisions.decision: S0 source shader and fresh matched-state observations prove static field tiles remain present independent of grid activation. The 0.72–0.75 ratio gates pulse/center effects, not whole-field visibility.
decisions.implementationConsequence: S2 removed the unsupported 0.50–0.54 field-opacity compensation and qualified shared rendered gates/clocks. Source camera is preserved; newly exposed local geometry mismatch remains R3+ visual debt. See repairs/s0/source/source-contract.md and repairs/s2/review.md.

decisions.decision: Measuring all 15 declared coarse primary structures does not establish complete evidence for a 100% visual and motion match. Core/glow equivalence, contextual silhouettes, surrounding marks, and intermediate motion still need validation.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Retain useful measurements and refine evidence per upcoming scene slice. Validate displayed source/local classifier overlays and add missing quality/motion checks; do not defer their feasibility to final polish or use coarse composition alone to accept city geometry. See audit A06/A08.

decisions.decision: The source-confirmed coordinates accepted by the user remain canonical. The red camera look-at path is distinct from four visible activation feeders, which also drive landing idle packets. The 31-to-40 construction applies specifically to blue route zero; local 0.25/0.75 fractions are not source timing.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Correct role-specific consumers, remove invented landing paths and disabled-depth rendering, and validate sampling/core/glow separately. At settled landing the current source camera formula already matches localhost; inspect geometry/material/depth before compensating with camera changes. Screen mismatch does not revoke verified coordinates or prove camera error. See audit A03/A04/A08.

decisions.decision: Source DOM progress is clamp((scrollY - 0.4H) / R, 0, 1), where R=max(flowHeight-wrapperHeight,1); scene target is max(0, scrollY / max(0.4H + R × 400/356,1)). DOM thresholds belong to DOM progress, not scene target.
decisions.implementationConsequence: S1 removed fitted capture mapping and forced controller/DOM outputs. Independent review accepted 245 formula samples, four before/after regressions, and focused physical-input browser checks. Full rendered/profile/production qualification remains S2/S7. See repairs/s1/review.md.

decisions.decision: Source camera and coupled route/field/arrival effects use damped cameraProgress; target-zero idle spawning is an explicit exception.
decisions.implementationConsequence: S2 installed one source-damped frame/clock owner and post-mutation readbacks; 11,562 controlled/ordinary development frames were validated with independent sampled-record review. Detached diagnostics cannot mutate outputs. S7 still owns full normal/direct and shipping-production qualification. See repairs/s2/review.md.

decisions.decision: Forced DOM/copy state and label-only convergence do not prove normal scroll behavior, rendered settlement, or native restoration.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Retain deterministic captures as a diagnostic tool; add normal-entry equivalence, interval playback, real rendered-state evidence, and explicit production smoke. Audit A05.

decisions.decision: Final visual anchor gates depend on geometry, materials, typography, and motion. Freezing them before those layers exist creates circular gates.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Qualify the foundation through repair sprints S0–S8 (R1/R2/R4), then pause for phase authorization. R3 remains the first visual implementation checkpoint: source-constrained camera, accurate layout, depth, materials, shadow/reflection, normal motion, and early performance measurement before expanding scene art. Audit A06.

decisions.decision: The user requested measurable subagent repair sprints before proceeding to the revised plan's phase implementation.
decisions.implementationConsequence: S0-S6 accepted within bounded repair scope with independent review. S6 acceptance binds the 2026-09-19-final evidence manifest and 2026-09-20 review. Proceed S7, then S8; pause for the user's decision before R3. R3 and visual phases remain excluded until that decision.

decisions.decision: Correcting connected-component membership changes 12 source measurement records /42 numeric leaves from unchanged reference pixels. This does not change accepted source world coordinates or visual targets.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Explicitly select recording-measurement-amendments-v1.json after verifying original manifest, source image and classifier hashes. Original anchors and 12 affected historical local records remain unchanged; S7 produces fresh local measurements. See repairs/s4/review.md.

decisions.decision: Fresh source backing matches audited localhost at recording desktop DPR2:2639×1331. Default1.75, narrow non-iOS mobile/tablet-UA1.5, iOS1.25 are source-backed caps, each limited by device DPR.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Do not raise DPR as an A09 repair merely to equal screenshot DPR. S5 repairs independent profile predicates/style/height rules and verifies actual backing. Any later quality deviation needs separate evidence/approval.

decisions.decision: The signed S6 review and acceptance record supersede the earlier blocked/no-packet summary for current status, without rewriting historical failed runs or broadening the acceptance scope.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Treat S6 as accepted only for its lifecycle and visible-DOM scope: 16/16 browser cases, 5 lifecycle tests, and both typechecks passed. Preserve the development-Chrome and emulated-resume limitations; proceed S7 → S8, then pause for the user's decision before R3. See repairs/s6/status.md, review.md, and acceptance.json.

decisions.decision: S0-S6 are accepted within bounded repair scope. S7 remains blocked with 0/336 qualified cells after three failed full-matrix passes. Corrected restoration and reverse-contact focused proofs pass 4/4, but the monolithic runner can catch its 12-minute test timeout and continue emitting closed-page fallout.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Do not rerun the monolithic matrix unchanged or increase its timeout. Independently review a fail-fast, same-build sharded runner and strict 360/336/24 merge contract before further execution. S8 is planned and unstarted, R3 remains unauthorized, and visual-fidelity acceptance must not be inferred.

decisions.decision: The fail-fast same-build sharded runner is implemented and independently reviewed. Its first executable pass retained 71 applicable mobile pass observations and stopped without fallout at arrival-travel/mobile/native-restored. Back navigation initially restored 4282px, then loader/layout reinitialization shifted to 5244px and selected journey-exit at sceneProgress 1.093661, so no lawful first-eligible arrival frame existed.
decisions.implementationConsequence: Do not inject or repair scroll after back, widen the target, change clocks, add N/A rows, or merge partial observations. The harness now bounds cell predicates explicitly and passes 28/28 focused controls, but runtime repair was outside the harness-only authorization. Keep S7 at 0/336 until separately authorized runtime work, fresh independent review, one new build/plan, a complete 336-pass packet, refreshed production checks, and final review. S8 and R3 remain unauthorized.

foundationAudit.scope: Acceptance corrections only; runtime repairs remain open.
